note: Frames RECORDED off the running app on a 402x874 pt simulator and normalised to the 393x852 pt reference space, not measured off Reference/*.png. The two are different measurements: an accessibility frame is the union of an element's children and a multi-line label's frame includes its whole line box, so a container reads taller here than the artwork does in a capture. Pixel fidelity against the reference is what Tools/snapshot/compare.sh scores; this spec is the layout regression guard underneath it.
